Ram Mandir Trust Faces Scrutiny Amid Donation and Theft Allegations

The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust is facing allegations of financial irregularities and theft concerning donations for the Ram Mandir. The Uttar Pradesh Congress chief has called for a judicial probe, accusing the BJP-RSS of "organised plunder." Reports indicate a crucial Trust meeting where the future of General Secretary Champat Rai was discussed, with some outlets reporting his resignation has been accepted.
